name: Brett T. Williamson
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Wheaton, Illinois
about: A family law attorney at The Stogsdill Law Firm, P.C., located in Wheaton, Illinois, Brett T. Williamson serves clients in the counties of Lake, DuPage, Kane, Kendall and Will. Focusing his practice exclusively on family law matters, he assists people who are going through a divorce and need his help with child custody, property division, child support and alimony. Mr. Williamson also handles paternity disputes and has experience in both collaborative law and mediation.

In 2002, Mr. Williamson obtained his Bachelor of Arts in history and English from Butler University. While in college, he was a member of the school's Division 1 lacrosse team. He then pursued his legal education at The John Marshall Law School and was awarded his Juris Doctor in 2005. Mr. Williamson is admitted to practice before all Illinois state courts.

An active participant in several legal organizations, Mr. Williamson is a member of the DuPage County Bar Association, Lake County Bar Association, the Will County Bar Association, The Chicago Bar Association and the Illinois State Bar Association. Named to Leading Lawyers for 2019-2024. The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40 in 2015-2019, he has also been named to the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys list of 10 Best under 40, and he has received a 10.0 "Superb" peer review rating through Avvo. He has also been a member of Rising Stars and now Super Lawyers since 2016, as well as Leading Lawyers from 2019-Present
